soundness_flags.label: def:finite-certificate and prop:finite-dimensional-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: The proposed coefficient-only real-elimination algorithm does not specify how it decides Göbler Condition 1, whose conditional densities can require marginalizing exp-polynomial laws and need not be polynomial or semialgebraic after conditioning.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: prop:finite-dimensional-certificate
